Elena (People Ops): Quick note 1 - Marcus' new hire Ben (Infra Eng, L3) starts Tue 9am PT. Dropping a tiny manager pocket-guide + who-to-ask microgrid you can paste into invites.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Perfect, thanks. Will need laptop + github access and a sandbox token beforehand if possible. Also planning a 20m intro + 30m infra tour.
Rohit (IT): Device order placed. Marcus - MacBook 14\" ok? I'll need the Slack channels and SSO groups to auto-join.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Yep MacBook 14\". Add to #infra, #oncall-shadow, #infra-announcements. SSO: aws-staging-read, gh-org.
Elena (People Ops): Paste-able manager pocket-guide (copy into calendar invite):
```
Manager pocket-guide - first week (copyable)
- Before day 1: Okta + device order (IT), Slack + calendar invites (People Ops), upload signed offer to #people-ops-private (manager).
- Day1 AM: 9:00 manager intro (20m) - team mission, top 3 priorities, 30/60/90 expectations. Buddy intro (10m). SSO + MFA smoke test.
- Day1 PM: 1pm "first-week map" with buddy, 3pm infra shadow run.
- Day2-3: dev env + repo access, assign low-risk sandbox task (rotate demo secret + open PR).
- Week1: daily short 1:1s, runbook tour, assign first PR reviewer and doc owner.
- 30/60/90 example: 30 map services & ship small change; 60 own component; 90 lead measurable reliability improvement.
- Feedback checkpoints: day3, week2, week4, then monthly.
```
Jules (Buddy): I'll be Ben's buddy. I'll send the first-week map and a 1-pager who-to-ask grid (IT, Security, Buddy, Oncall, Docs) and schedule a casual lunch Tue 12pm.
Asha (Security): We'll run a 15m credentials & secrets quickstart Mon 4pm (pre-read attached). Onboarding tasks will use sandbox tokens only - no prod creds.
Rohit (IT): Provisioning sandbox service account with 1h TTL tokens now. Will DM ephemeral token flow and laptop pickup ETA (Mon 9am).
OnboardBot: New-hire checklist created: https://onboard.example/2310456789 :tada:
Marcus (Eng Manager): Great checklist. I'll drop the signed offer into #people-ops-private and add the feedback cadence to Ben's calendar. Anything else to add?
Elena (People Ops): Maybe add a small note to check calendar timezone and working hours visibility for remote folks. Added. Good luck Ben! :seedling:
